title: अध्याय ९५

items.speaker: मार्कण्डेय उवाच
items.text:
ततस्तस्मान्नदीमध्यात्समुत्तस्थौ मनोरमा ।
प्रम्लोचा नाम तन्वङ्गी तत्समीपे वराप्सराः ॥ १ ॥
items.tr:
tatastasmānnadīmadhyātsamuttasthau manoramā |
pramlocā nāma tanvaṅgī tatsamīpe varāpsarāḥ || 1 ||

items.text:
सा चोवाच महात्मानं रुचिं सुमधुराक्षरम् ।
प्रश्रयावनता सुभूः प्रम्लोचा वै वराप्सराः ॥ २ ॥
items.tr:
sā covāca mahātmānaṃ ruciṃ sumadhurākṣaram |
praśrayāvanatā subhūḥ pramlocā vai varāpsarāḥ || 2 ||

items.text:
अतीव रूपिणी कन्या मत्सुता तपतां वर ।
जाता वरुणपुत्रेण पुष्करेण महात्मना ॥ ३ ॥
items.tr:
atīva rūpiṇī kanyā matsutā tapatāṃ vara |
jātā varuṇaputreṇa puṣkareṇa mahātmanā || 3 ||

items.text:
तां गृहाण मया दत्तां भार्यार्थे वरवर्णिनीम् ।
मनुर्महामतिस्तस्यां समुत्पस्यति ते सुतः ॥ ४ ॥
items.tr:
tāṃ gṛhāṇa mayā dattāṃ bhāryārthe varavarṇinīm |
manurmahāmatistasyāṃ samutpasyati te sutaḥ || 4 ||

items.speaker: मार्कण्डेय उवाच
items.text:
तथेति तेन साऽप्युक्ता तस्मात्तोयाद्वपुष्मतीम् ।
उज्जहार ततः कन्यां मालिनी नाम नामतः ॥ ५ ॥
items.tr:
tatheti tena sā'pyuktā tasmāttoyādvapuṣmatīm |
ujjahāra tataḥ kanyāṃ mālinī nāma nāmataḥ || 5 ||

items.text:
नद्याश्च पुलिने तस्मिन्स रुचिर्मुनिसत्तमः ।
जग्राह पाणिं विधिवत्समानाय्य महामुनीन् ॥ ६ ॥
items.tr:
nadyāśca puline tasminsa rucirmunisattamaḥ |
jagrāha pāṇiṃ vidhivatsamānāyya mahāmunīn || 6 ||

items.text:
तस्यां तस्य सुतो जज्ञे महावीर्यो महामतिः ।
रौच्योऽभवत्पितुर्नाम्ना ख्यातोऽत्र वसुधातले ॥ ७ ॥
items.tr:
tasyāṃ tasya suto jajñe mahāvīryo mahāmatiḥ |
raucyo'bhavatpiturnāmnā khyāto'tra vasudhātale || 7 ||

items.text:
तस्य मन्वन्तरे देवास्तथा सप्तर्षयश्च ये ।
तनयाश्च नृपाश्चैव ते सम्यक्कथितास्तव ॥ ८ ॥
items.tr:
tasya manvantare devāstathā saptarṣayaśca ye |
tanayāśca nṛpāścaiva te samyakkathitāstava || 8 ||

items.text:
पितृस्तवं तथा श्रुत्वा पितॄणां च तथा गणान् ।
सर्वान्कामानवाप्नोति तत्प्रसादान्महामुने ॥ १० ॥
items.tr:
pitṛstavaṃ tathā śrutvā pitṝṇāṃ ca tathā gaṇān |
sarvānkāmānavāpnoti tatprasādānmahāmune || 10 ||

en_summary: Markandeya tells Kraushtuki that, after the ancestors left, a lovely, slender apsaras named Pramlocha rose from the middle of the river nearby. Bowing modestly, she spoke sweetly to the great Ruchi: she had a very beautiful daughter, born to her from Pushkara, the great son of Varuna; she offered this girl to him as his wife, and by her he would have a son, a wise Manu. Ruchi agreed, and she brought out of the water the lovely girl named Malini. On the bank of the river Ruchi called the great sages and took her hand in marriage by the proper rite. By her he had a son of great strength and wisdom, known on earth by his father's name as Raucya. The gods, seven sages, sons and kings of his Manu period have already been told. When this Manu period is heard, people surely gain growth in dharma, health, wealth, grain and sons; and one who hears the hymn to the ancestors and the groups of ancestors gains all desires by their grace.
